svg.title: Samvriti.Space — The Kite
svg.desc: One unbroken line, and it runs the other way from the rest of the family: it begins at the still centre of the wound thread, unwinds two and a third turns off the reel, crosses a wide empty field as a slack string — and where it reaches the kite it does not stop and it does not become something else. It goes straight on up through the middle as the spine, then out around the four edges and back, so that the thing holding the kite down and the thing holding the kite up are one length of thread. Drawn as a single circuit of the frame: nose, spine, top, left, nose again, right, top. Left open where the paper would tear. One path, one M, no Z.
